headline: Oblivion Milestone 1
summary: The first Oblivion-focused update adds the OblivionMod and Oblivion News feed configuration, an updated Ave Mujica-inspired palette, and an Xbox profile panel on the home screen.

items.text: Added the Oblivion Modder credit and updated the project repository links.
Added the active Microsoft gamertag and Xbox profile avatar to the launcher home screen, with a shortcut to the existing skin-pack manager.
Moved the news and mod catalog endpoints to optional Oblivion-owned configuration. Empty endpoints use the bundled data.
Applied a charcoal, muted lavender, and plum visual palette inspired by Ave Mujica.
